title: CoANet: Connectivity Attention Network for Road Extraction From Satellite Imagery
mechanism: Decoder built from strip convolutions in 4 directions (horizontal, vertical, two diagonals) plus a connectivity attention module predicting 8-neighbour links, for long thin occluded roads.
adaptation: Replace U-Net++ decoder blocks with 4-direction strip-conv blocks. EL cells are axis-aligned, so h/v strips match fingers (gridline), busbars, ribbons, splice, borders; diagonals serve cracks.
min_experiment: Arm: strip-conv decoder, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metrics: gridline IoU, splice IoU, mIoU_rob, crack relF1@2. Kill: gridline IoU gain < 0.03 and mIoU_rob gain < 0.005.
evidence: Improved road connectivity on DeepGlobe and SpaceNet (abstract; numbers not read; snippet search rate-limited).

alt_notes.adaptation: Add strip blocks to the U-Net++ decoder for gridline, splice and crack. Add an auxiliary 8-channel connectivity target derived from the crack and gridline masks. Connectivity of a 1-2 px line is unchanged by a 1 px shift.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Strip blocks + connectivity head vs house, 5 seeds. Metrics: gridline IoU (CV), crack components found, crack relF1@2. Kill if gridline gains < 0.03 and crack is flat.
